mechanism: exp-0015a's native FP4xFP4 prefill grouped MMA + Triton NVFP4 activation quant, rebased onto the accepted 0008-0013 decode lineage (stale-base fix); decode stays W4A16 CUDA-graphed
hypothesis: exp-0015a's 93.0 and main's 89.7 measure DISJOINT halves of the engine and neither is the combination. exp-0015a's commit 09ae5fa is not a descendant of main (git merge-base --is-ancestor 09ae5fa main -> NO): it branches from 42b5457, which predates merge 99f6bbc ('brings the chained accepted lineage 0008-0012; ff refused'), and its tree has NO graphrun.py (git ls-tree -r 09ae5fa | grep graphrun -> empty) plus separate attn_global.py / attn_swa.py / moe_gemm.py / kv.py / scheduler.py — so 93.0 is W4A4 prefill on a pre-0012 decode, while 89.7 is the 0008-0013 decode on a W4A16 prefill. This spec measures the two together: the SAME validated mechanism rebased onto current main e1666ee (conflict-free; kernels/moe_gemm_w4a4.py, kernels/fp4_quant.py and loader.py are byte-identical to the accepted tree per git diff --quiet 09ae5fa HEAD, and model.py differs from it only by main's 0008-0013 content). One-variable audit: the diff vs main adds kernels/fp4_quant.py, kernels/moe_gemm_w4a4.py and the vendored BSD-3 CUTLASS DSL, threads a phase= kwarg through model.py, and adds PackedExperts.input_amax — no other engine file; only model.py:432 (layer_prefill) passes phase='prefill', while model.py:538 (layer_decode), model.py:872 (layer_decode_batch) and graphrun.py:248 all take the default phase='decode', so the CUDA-graphed step stays bit-identical W4A16. The serving loader really is the patched site (server.py:91/119 loads via t_b2.load_layer_weights). Cycle model: main's 89.7 block = 91.3 s per 64-seq/8192-tok cohort = ~61 s serial prefill + ~30.4 s decode; W4A4 cuts the measured per-layer MoE prefill wall 20.29 -> 4.11 ms (4.9x, t_moe_w4a4 arm f on real layer-3 experts), i.e. the ~75-80% expert-GEMM share of the 0.95 s/seq prefill -> 0.34-0.39 s/seq -> prefill term 22-25 s, and 30.4 + 23 = ~53 s/cohort. The same arithmetic read backwards on exp-0015a's own 88.1 s cohort implies its pre-0012 decode term was ~63-66 s, which is what the 0008-0013 lineage replaces.
